name: Animals Having A Soul
overview: Scripture reveals that animals possess life and are described as having a living soul, as seen in Genesis where God commands the earth to bring forth living creatures and grants them life (Genesis 1:24, 1:30). While man is uniquely formed by God and given the breath of life to become a living soul (Genesis 2:7), animals also share in the breath of life, evidenced by Noah bringing pairs of every living creature into the ark (Genesis 7:15). Job further affirms that the soul and breath of all living things, including animals and mankind, are in God's hand (Job 12:10), highlighting God's sovereign control over all life. Additionally, animals are portrayed as part of God's creation that can instruct us in understanding His wisdom (Job 12:7).
